scope: Preserve accepted V4 nested SE routes and native SE behavior; D60/D66 unchanged.

facts: rETH conversions use RocketNetworkBalances oracle totals, which ordinary deposit/burn does not update. Do not incorrectly use actual ERC20 totalSupply as the conversion denominator.

WETH-to-SE issuance credits the incoming WETH first, mints user/usage-fee shares, then soft-stakes excess toward the liquid target. Capacity, minimum deposit, disabled deposits and deposit fees can change the resulting book.
RocketDepositPool deposits mint getRethValue(amount minus floor(amount times depositFee/WAD)). getMaximumDepositAmount exposes capacity but not the fee or minimum.
Current three-field SE PkgArgs expose rETH, WETH and depositPool. RocketBase stores RocketStorage internally, with no public getter. No additional deployment argument has been selected or applied.

WETH payouts can burn held rETH; collateral includes rETH contract ETH plus excess deposit-pool ETH. Projecting sequential deposits and burns requires actual capacity/collateral economics, not an assumed unchanged share rate.
Existing HermeticDepositPool uses optional depositFeeBps, a capacity setter and disabled-deposit getter behavior; these are external protocol-shaped test ports, not the SE SUT.
NAV is WETH plus held weETH converted to ETH plus pending withdrawal face; idle eETH is excluded. Track idle eETH separately for transfer/wrap rounding.
WETH-to-SE mints shares before staking excess. The split repeats once if the updated sleeve remains above target plus a ten-percent target band.

Live deposit increases pooled ETH and mints floor(amount times existing shares/pooled ETH). The SE measures its eETH balance delta and wraps that delta, so existing idle eETH and fractional rounding matter.

Live EETH exposes totalShares and shares(account). Existing HermeticEETH instead has a fixed virtual getTotalShares and nonrebasing ERC20 balances; HermeticWeETH carries a configurable fixed conversion rate. Do not mistake these two external protocol models for each other.

Optional instant redemption tries five-percent gross headroom (minimum one wei), caps by held weETH, checks canRedeem and retries the bare shortfall. Failure can legitimately leave an insufficient WETH sleeve.

Actual manager previewRedeem is not the exact multi-rounding execution formula. _calcRedemption floors sharesForAmount, floors fee-adjusted receiver shares, converts to assets, ceilings withdrawal shares, then separately floors treasury fee shares.

Actual manager tokenToRedemptionInfo returns a static Limit of four uint64 fields plus three uint16 fee/low-watermark values. The bucket scale is 1e12; projected consumption rounds ETH face up to bucket units. Liquidity and low watermark change with pooled ETH and redemptions.

HermeticRedemptionManager intentionally treats weETH amount as one-to-one ETH face in redeemWeEth even though its canRedeem receives converted face. Tests of live fractional execution must use actual protocol evidence, not assume this stub reproduces canonical fee rounding.
